svg.title: What it costs to store two sessions
svg.desc: Tokens read to store the example's two sessions. Textual memory: 916 tokens in 2 LLM calls. Mem0: 16,862 tokens in 2 LLM calls and 4 embedding calls. Zep / Graphiti: 60,374 tokens in 38 LLM calls and 25 embedding calls, split by step: finding entities 24,118 tokens in 10 calls, matching them 7,194 in 7, extracting facts 19,166 in 10, comparing with stored facts 9,896 in 11. Below, Graphiti's LLM calls for each of the ten messages: 2, 3, 6 in session 1 and 5, 4, 4, 2, 5, 2, 5 in session 2; the assistant's four messages took 11 of the 38 calls and produced one fact.
svg.text: What it costs to store two sessions
Tokens the model read to store the same two sessions, ten short messages. Graphiti makes several calls per message,
each with a long fixed prompt, and one more call for every new fact.
GRAPHITI'S LLM CALLS, MESSAGE BY MESSAGE
The assistant's four messages took 11 of the 38 calls and produced one fact: that the assistant acknowledged fish was now included. The entity
prompt, read for every message, is about 2,400 tokens each time.
From notebooks 01, 02 and 03 (section 7); answering calls not counted
